question: The 73rd Amendment Act of 1992 gave constitutional recognition to the panchayats by adding a new part ________to the constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is** __IX__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 73rd amendment act 1992 gave constitutional recognition to Panchayats.
 
• It added a new part to the constitution Part IX with articles Articles 243 to 243 (O).
 
• It also included an 11th Schedule in the constitution which contains **29** functional items of Municipalities mentioned in Article 243-G.
